summary: The mutation *list* endpoint's real response shape has no per-line `rows` breakdown -- only top-level `amount`/`ledgerId` -- so any command computing amounts from a plain `sync` must use those top-level fields; the `rows` breakdown only exists on the `GET /v1/mutation/{id}` detail response and requires `mutation get-id` write-through-caching to become available locally.
reason: The OpenAPI spec's list schema (`MutationsResponseDto`) was an undefined `$ref`, generator-stubbed as a permissive object matching the (correct) detail schema. Live testing showed the real list response only exposes `amount`/`ledgerId`, so `mutation suggest`, `ledger history`'s row matching, and `relation statement`'s amount computation silently returned 0/empty against real synced data until switched to the top-level fields. `report vat-summary` now documents that full VAT-row coverage depends on caching individual mutations via `mutation get-id`, not a plain sync.

validated_outcome: Verified live against real synced mutation data: mutation suggest, ledger history, and relation statement compute correct non-zero amounts from top-level fields; vat-summary's documented caveat matches actual coverage.
